description: Persian Dataset V2 source and licensing catalog. Rights describe the actual text, not merely a repository/compilation. Not legal advice.

profiles.A: PERMISSIVE CORE - only sources with verified underlying content rights
profiles.B: RESEARCH ONLY - clearly documented non-commercial sources, physically separate output
profiles.C: QUARANTINE - unknown/conflicting rights, provenance or privacy concerns; do not train

sources.attribution_required: yes (link to article/history or contributor list)
sources.description: Official Wikimedia current-revisions dump; primary modern factual Persian prose.
sources.name: Persian Wikipedia official articles dump (2026-10-01)
sources.notes: Use the dated 20261001 pages-articles file, not the mutable 'latest' symlink. CC BY-SA share-alike may affect redistributed derived corpus; this is not legal advice.
sources.rights_verification: official Wikimedia ToU and dump index

sources.description: Free textbooks/how-to prose; small but genuinely educational modern Persian.
sources.name: Persian Wikibooks official articles dump (2026-11-01)
sources.notes: Small source; useful as explanatory/educational register, not as a volume filler.
sources.rights_verification: official Wikimedia ToU and dump index

sources.commercial_use: yes for PD/free pages with conditions
sources.description: Public-domain or freely licensed source texts; literary/historical prose and verse.
sources.license_content: per-page: public domain or compatible free license; page contributions CC BY-SA 4.0
sources.name: Persian Wikisource official articles dump (2026-11-01)
sources.notes: Extractor keeps only pages with an explicit PD/CC/GPL-compatible license template; unlabeled pages are skipped and counted. Classical register, not modern prose.
sources.rights_verification: official Wikisource copyright policy and dump index

sources.description: Collaboratively written news-style Persian prose; small, modern register.
sources.name: Persian Wikinews official articles dump (2026-11-01)
sources.notes: Wikinews is licensed CC BY 2.5, NOT CC BY-SA 4.0; keep its license tag distinct in the manifest.

sources.description: Natural short Persian sentences contributed to / collected for Common Voice; text only, no audio.
sources.license_content: CC0 1.0 for sentence text (repository README states sentence text is CC0)
sources.name: Mozilla Common Voice Persian sentence files (CC0 text)
sources.notes: One natural sentence per document; no artificial merging. Do not use audio or speaker metadata. Short-sentence quality profile applies.
sources.rights_verification: Common Voice repository README + Mozilla release statement

sources.attribution_required: yes: author name must be retained
sources.description: Crowd-sourced natural Persian example sentences; detailed export retains author name for attribution.
sources.language_purity: Persian short sentences, some translated phrasing
sources.license_content: CC BY 2.0 FR by default; some CC0
sources.name: Tatoeba Persian sentences (CC BY 2.0 FR, author attribution)
sources.notes: The CC0-only export does NOT include Persian; use detailed export and store usernames in the manifest (not in training text). One sentence per document.
sources.rights_verification: official Tatoeba downloads and terms of use

sources.attribution_required: yes (Ganjoor + GPL notice for redistributed data files)
sources.commercial_use: yes for PD works; GPL obligations for data files
sources.description: Classical Persian poetry/prose from ganjoor-tex; only pre-modern poet directories in the allowlist.
sources.license_content: underlying classical works are public domain; transcription/typesetting may be GPL-3.0
sources.name: Ganjoor classical works, public-domain-only subset
sources.notes: Only the 12 classical directories present at the pinned commit are allowed. A modern poet's work must NOT be added until its rights are verified. One source file per document; no cross-file stitching.
sources.rights_verification: GitHub GPL-3.0 license file + classical author list
sources.share_alike: GPL-3.0 may apply to redistributed data files

sources.description: Public-domain classical poems with an explicitly CC BY-SA 4.0 compilation.
sources.name: Chronological Persian Poetry Dataset (CC BY-SA 4.0)
sources.notes: One poem per document; no artificial 3,200-character blocks. V1 merged unrelated poems; V2 does not.

sources.description: The 865k-article cleaned CSV used by V1; recoverable from split 7z parts in a GitHub mirror.
sources.name: V1 Wikipedia 2021 cleaned CSV mirror (optional recovery source)
sources.notes: Optional. Prefer the official 2026 dump for modern Persian. This source is included to audit V1's claim that 538M filtered characters were recoverable.
sources.rights_verification: Wikimedia ToU; V1 sources.json; mirror README

sources.description: Explicitly CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 Persian task annotations. Research-only, separate output.
sources.name: ParsiNLU QA / multiple-choice / entailment annotations
sources.notes: Excludes reading-comprehension passages taken from publisher-copyright news. Do not include synthetic task markers in the main corpus; keep natural text fields only.
sources.redistribution: yes only under NC-SA and research conditions

sources.description: Publisher-copyright news articles; no license declared.
sources.name: V1 Persian news corpus (5 agencies)
sources.notes: Quarantine: public download does not grant rights to underlying articles. Do not train on it.

sources.description: MIT repository but publisher-copyright news text; V1 quality gate also rejected it.
sources.name: V1 pn-summary news articles
sources.notes: Quarantine: underlying rights unverified and punctuation was stripped upstream.
sources.rights_verification: MIT does not cover article text

sources.approx_size: about 3 MB released subset; full 14M pairs external
sources.description: 14M public tweets/replies; MIT repository does not license the tweets.
sources.name: V1 PeQa Twitter-derived dialogue
sources.notes: Quarantine: identifiable personal social-media content and unverified underlying rights.

sources.description: 130 GB / ~250M paragraphs / ~15B words; mixed Common Crawl, news, Telegram, private company corpus, blogs.
sources.license_content: underlying web/Telegram/private texts; not licensed by the compilation
sources.name: SLPL/naab cleaned Persian web corpus
sources.notes: QUARANTINE. Do not download the full 137 GB. MIT metadata and 'mit?' card do not license crawled pages, Telegram messages, or formerly private data.
sources.rights_verification: card explicitly takes no responsibility for personal information

sources.description: 6.25M rows / 5.97 GB across 14 sites; contains BBC Persian, Civilica, blogs, generated retrieval queries.
sources.license_content: underlying web content remains subject to original authors' rights and site terms
sources.name: shekar-ai/Shiraz Persian web corpus
sources.notes: QUARANTINE. ODC-BY covers selection/annotations only; BBC and Civilica content has separate rights. Synthetic query columns must never enter pretraining.
sources.rights_verification: dataset card explicitly disclaims granting underlying content rights

sources.description: 98.6 GB / 75M documents / 41B claimed tokens scraped from 800+ sites; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 compilation.
sources.license_content: scraped third-party web pages plus reader comments with commenter names/dates
sources.name: Targoman Large Persian Corpus (TLPC)
sources.notes: QUARANTINE by default, despite a clear NC license: documented personal data (names/dates in comments) and uncertain third-party rights. Conditional PROFILE B only after documented PII scrubbing and review.

sources.description: 2.8M articles / 1.4B words from 250+ news sites; password-controlled full release.
sources.name: MirasText news corpus
sources.notes: QUARANTINE. Do not request or bypass the archive password from this pipeline.
sources.rights_verification: MIT repo does not license articles; access control present

sources.description: 65 GB Common Crawl + MirasText + W2C + Wikipedia + Leipzig + VOA + poems + TEP; no license.
sources.name: persiannlp/persian-raw-text 80 GB mixture
sources.notes: QUARANTINE. No deduplication upstream, mixed rights, Common Crawl terms push copyright responsibility to the user.

sources.description: Common-Crawl-derived Persian subsets; dataset licenses do not grant rights to crawled pages.
sources.name: OSCAR-fa / CC-100-fa / CulturaX-fa / FineWeb-2-fa family
sources.notes: QUARANTINE. Common Crawl explicitly states crawled content may carry separate terms and users must respect third-party rights.

sources.description: Newspaper articles used for IR/NLP research; license unknown on redistributions.
sources.name: Hamshahri Persian news corpus
sources.notes: QUARANTINE: unknown license and publisher copyright.

sources.description: ~2.6M-word tagged corpus widely used in Persian NLP; rights and redistribution terms not established here.
sources.name: Bijankhan / Peykare tagged corpus
sources.notes: QUARANTINE pending authoritative license documentation.

sources.description: 27M casual Persian sentences; used as an informal component of naab.
sources.name: Large Scale Colloquial Persian (LSCP)
sources.notes: QUARANTINE: underlying casual-text provenance and rights were not verified.

sources.description: Large poem collection with no repository license.
sources.license_content: classical PD poems but compilation unverified
sources.name: amnghd/Persian_poems_corpus
sources.notes: QUARANTINE; use the CC BY-SA Chronological dataset instead.

sources.description: 17M samples aggregated from Bijankhan, medical QA, Wikipedia, and other corpora.
sources.license_content: mixed upstream corpora with differing rights
sources.name: PersianPunc punctuation-restoration corpus
sources.notes: QUARANTINE: CC BY 4.0 compilation does not settle Bijankhan/medical QA rights; task-specific sentence fragments.

sources.description: 3.5M EN-FA parallel sentences; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
sources.name: Esposito English-Persian scientific parallel corpus
sources.notes: EXCLUDE: bilingual/parallel objective, NC, and not naturally occurring Persian-only documents.

sources.description: ~5.9K Persian conversations in ChatML; CC BY 4.0.
sources.name: mshojaei77/persian-gk synthetic chat
sources.notes: EXCLUDE from V2 pretraining: instruction/synthetic chat belongs to the later conversational stage.

sources.description: ASR/TTS transcripts mined from in-the-wild audio or magazines; CC BY/CC0 claims vary.
sources.license_content: web audio/video or magazine text; rights unclear
sources.name: PersianVox / ManaTTS / ParsiGoo transcripts
sources.notes: EXCLUDE: audio-derived short utterances, possible personal data, not natural documents.

sources.description: Lexicographic entries, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 compilation.
sources.name: Dehkhoda dictionary dump
sources.notes: EXCLUDE: dictionary fragments are not natural prose and NC applies.

sources.description: Quotations and dictionary entries; CC BY-SA but not natural documents and may quote copyrighted works.
sources.name: Persian Wikiquote / Wiktionary dumps
sources.notes: EXCLUDE from pretraining; not natural continuous Persian prose.

sources.description: Official legal texts may be excluded from copyright, but no authoritative bulk open-licensed release was verified.
sources.name: Iranian laws / official gazette bulk text
sources.notes: QUARANTINE pending an authoritative government source and rights statement.

sources.description: Mostly English translations of classical Persian works; public domain in USA but not Persian-language prose.
sources.name: Project Gutenberg Persian-language / Persian literature books
sources.notes: EXCLUDE: not Persian-language modern prose. A few PD Persian books on Internet Archive need OCR and per-work rights review; not part of V2.

sources.description: 7.9M-word VOA corpus; possible US-government public-domain status not authoritatively verified here.
sources.name: VOA Persian 2003-2008 corpus
sources.notes: QUARANTINE pending an authoritative rights statement.
